q1_issues.issue: (LocatedIn sk_group_1 sk_round_1) puts an event witness in LocatedIn's place slot — 'are in today's third round' states participation in a competition stage, not spatial containment in a place.
The per-member distribution rule propagates the same mis-slotted head, asserting of each kid that it is spatially contained in the round.

q2_gaps: being 'in' an event / competition stage ('X is in the third round', 'in the final', 'in the draw') — participation has no licensed head; the 'Where a THING is' section supplies LocatedIn only for a thing in a place

Ordinal's <scale> slot when the entity is ranked within a sequence of its own kind ('the third round'): the scale is specified as the associated event or an explicit '-est' dimension, neither of which exists here
notes: Group + (Cardinality sk_group_1 2), the entity-attached origin (From sk_group_1 michigan), and the bare deictic 'today' as a Time on the event-denoting noun 'round' all follow the instruction set, as does adding the per-member rule beside the group atom. The origin PP is attached to the group symbol only while the predicate is distributed to members — an inconsistency the instruction set does not settle for a PP post-modifier on a plural.
